vivaldi-spring.share_alike: ALL vivaldi-spring-*.mp3 files, their cue JSON, performance plans and the Spring portions of the timeline are released under CC BY-SA 3.0. vivaldi-spring.changes: Tempo quarter=104, expressive articulation/dynamics, score-indicated trills and mordents realized, existing score cello retained. Concert shortens birdsong repetitions. Accident abbreviates opening/closing ritornelli and pairs the score violin gestures with an original NumPy songbird whistle synthesis: curious contact calls, curved answers about two octaves higher, FM warbles, accelerating rising AM trills, cadence tweets and a flight call. Its original violin/orchestra notes and timing are preserved. Wreck changes solo timing and pitch; orchestra retains score pitches.
vivaldi-spring.filename_correction: spring-score-1.mid is the Largo (3/4, quarter=50, C-sharp minor); spring-score.mid is the Allegro (4/4, quarter=115 in source, E major), verified against spring1.ly.
